description: Inspect sequence, project item, clip and requested track targets before previewing a compound timeline edit without changing Premiere. Returns a single-use confirmation token bound to stable project, sequence and target identities; it expires after 30 minutes and is required by apply_edit_plan.

plan.description: An edit plan: { sequence_id?, operations: [...] } with up to 100 insert_clip and remove_clip operations. Operations run in order, and each one's times refer to the timeline as the operations before it left it.

allow_large_ripple.description: ripple remove_clip: allow execution above large_ripple_threshold after the read-only mover estimate

include_linked.description: remove_clip without ripple: also remove linked audio/video partners (default true)

item_id.description: insert_clip: project item node ID or name

large_ripple_threshold.description: ripple remove_clip: refuse above this mover count unless allow_large_ripple is true (default 400)

ripple.description: remove_clip: close the gap with a verified sync-locked ripple delete (always takes linked partners)

start_seconds.description: insert_clip: timeline insert time in seconds (insert edit, sync-locked tracks shift)

sequence_id.description: Sequence name or ID to edit (activated first); defaults to the active sequence

name: preview_edit_plan

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Preview Edit Plan
